flags.what: 'to jump high into the sky' (ex1 phrase 2 / ex4 row 1) is unnatural; natives say 'into the air'

fix.before: to jump high into the sky
fix.after: to jump out of the water

flags.why: 'jump out of the water' is the everyday phrase for this still (dolphin leaping above the water, splash below); 'the water' is a visible thing filling the lower half of the still; the chip 'the water' fits no map node and not the other row 'to land with [a splash]'

flags.what: ex1 'to lie on the grass' (target the apple): apples are inside the bag
flags.why: the video shows it: in frame 62_05 an apple has fallen out and lies on the grass at the bottom right; the tap target is visible during playback

flags.what: ex1 'to pick up an apple' (target the man): nobody picks up an apple
flags.why: in the video the apple jumps back into the bag by itself (frame 06); the man never picks it up. In the still his hand holds a water bottle above the bag (top-left). The chip 'a water bottle' fits no map node and not 'to lie on [ ]'

flags.what: ex3 caption 3 'I will select a cake.' stiff

fix.after: They will select a cake together.
They will select a cake together.
They will select a cake together.

flags.why: 'I will select' with no speaker in the picture is stiff and wrong-person (two people walk toward the cake window); 'They will select a cake together.' describes the picture, is a natural future caption and keeps the chip 'will select'

flags.what: ex3 caption 2 'classical architecture' while the room is baroque/rococo
flags.why: in everyday US English 'classical architecture' is loosely used for ornate old European palace rooms; the picture (arched windows, pilasters, painted ceiling) reads that way to a B-level learner, and no other 'classical + noun' fits the picture better

more.before: So they reached over the glass and grabbed three.

more.why: after 'Max ... His friend', 'they' reads as Max and the friend together; a singular pronoun keeps the one order and the joke (bModels keep 'friend'/'person' as subject; 'she' fits both)
